ar.title: إعادة رسم الخرائط في منتصف العقد: كيف يمكن لصراعات الدوائر الانتخابية أن تحسم السيطرة على مجلس النواب

segments.src: Congressional district maps are usually redrawn once every ten years, after the census.
segments.tr: عادةً ما يتم إعادة رسم خرائط الدوائر الانتخابية مرة كل عشر سنوات، بعد التعداد السكاني.

segments.src: In this cycle, several states have taken the unusual step of redrawing lines in the middle of the decade.
segments.tr: في هذه الدورة، اتخذت عدة ولايات خطوة غير معتادة تتمثل في إعادة رسم الحدود في منتصف العقد.

segments.src: Lawmakers, governors, voters and judges are all part of the argument, and the maps themselves have become a campaign story.
segments.tr: يُعد المشرعون والحكام والناخبون والقضاة جزءاً من هذا النقاش، وقد أصبحت الخرائط نفسها جزءاً من قصة الحملة الانتخابية.

segments.src: This explainer covers how redistricting works, why a handful of seats can matter so much, and what courts have said so far.
segments.tr: يشرح هذا المقال كيف يعمل إعادة تقسيم الدوائر، ولماذا يمكن لعدد قليل من المقاعد أن يكون بهذه الأهمية، وما الذي قالته المحاكم حتى الآن.

segments.src: ## How Redistricting Normally Works
segments.tr: ## كيف يعمل إعادة تقسيم الدوائر عادة

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: يحتوي مجلس النواب الأمريكي

segments.src: House has 435 voting seats.
segments.tr: على 435 مقعداً تصويتياً.

segments.src: Each state's share of those seats depends on its population, which the Constitution requires the federal government to count every ten years.
segments.tr: تعتمد حصة كل ولاية من هذه المقاعد على عدد سكانها، والذي يطلب الدستور من الحكومة الفيدرالية إحصاءه كل عشر سنوات.

segments.src: After each census, seats are reapportioned among the states.
segments.tr: بعد كل تعداد سكاني، يتم إعادة توزيع المقاعد بين الولايات.

segments.src: Each state then draws the boundaries for its own congressional districts.
segments.tr: ثم ترسم كل ولاية الحدود الخاصة بدوائرها الانتخابية.

segments.src: Who draws those lines depends on the state:
segments.tr: من يقوم برسم هذه الحدود يعتمد على الولاية:

segments.src: - **State legislatures** draw the maps in most states. The governor can often sign or veto the plan.
segments.tr: - **المجالس التشريعية للولايات** ترسم الخرائط في معظم الولايات. وغالباً ما يمكن للحاكم توقيع الخطة أو استخدام حق الفيتو ضدها.

segments.src: - **Independent or bipartisan commissions** draw the maps in a smaller group of states, including California, Colorado, Michigan and Arizona. The rules for these commissions vary widely.
segments.tr: - **اللجان المستقلة أو الحزبية المشتركة** ترسم الخرائط في مجموعة أصغر من الولايات، بما في ذلك كاليفورنيا وكولورادو وميشิغان وأريزونا. تختلف قواعد هذه اللجان بشكل كبير.

segments.src: - **Courts** sometimes step in and draw or adopt a map when the political branches cannot agree or when a map is struck down.
segments.tr: - **المحاكم** تتدخل أحياناً وترسم أو تعتمد خريطة عندما لا تستطيع الفروع السياسية الاتفاق أو عندما يتم إلغاء خريطة ما.

segments.src: Districts must contain roughly equal populations, and they must comply with the Voting Rights Act, which restricts maps that unlawfully weaken the voting strength of racial or language minority groups.
segments.tr: يجب أن تحتوي الدوائر على أعداد متساوية تقريباً من السكان، ويجب أن تمتثل لقانون حقوق التصويت، الذي تقيد الخرائط التي تضعف بشكل غير قانوني القوة التصويتية للأقليات العرقية أو اللغوية.

segments.src: Many states add their own rules, such as requiring compact or contiguous districts or keeping counties and communities together.
segments.tr: تضيف العديد من الولايات قواعدها الخاصة، مثل اشتراط أن تكون الدوائر مدمجة أو متجاورة أو إبقاء المقاطعات والمجتمعات معا.

segments.src: ## Why "Mid-Decade" Redistricting Is Unusual
segments.tr: ## لماذا يُعد إعادة تقسيم الدوائر في "منتصف العقد" أمراً غير معتاد

segments.src: Nothing in federal law bars a state from drawing new congressional lines between censuses.
segments.tr: لا يوجد شيء في القانون الفيدرالي يمنع أي ولاية من رسم حدود انتخابية جديدة بين عمليات التعداد.

segments.src: In practice it has been uncommon, because the new census is meant to be the natural reset point.
segments.tr: في الممارسة العملية، كان هذا الأمر غير شائع، لأن التعداد الجديد يُقصد به أن يكون نقطة إعادة ضبط طبيعية.

segments.src: Some states restrict mid-decade changes in their constitutions or statutes, and others do not.
segments.tr: تقيد بعض الولايات التغييرات في منتصف العقد في دساتيرها أو قوانينها، بينما لا يفعل البعض الآخر ذلك.

segments.src: There are precedents.
segments.tr: توجد سوابق تاريخية.

segments.src: Texas redrew its congressional map in 2003, and the Supreme Court later reviewed parts of that plan in *LULAC v.
segments.tr: أعاد تكساس رسم خريطتها الانتخابية في عام 2003، ومحكمة العليا راجعت لاحقاً أجزاء من تلك الخطة في قضية *LULAC v.

segments.src: What has changed in this cycle is the scale and the back-and-forth nature of the effort.
segments.tr: ما تغير في هذه الدورة هو النطاق وطبيعة الردود المتبادلة للجهد.

segments.src: Moves in one state have been publicly tied to responses in others.
segments.tr: تم ربط التحركات في ولاية ما علناً بالردود في ولايات أخرى.

segments.src: Supporters of the new maps describe them as a lawful use of a state's authority or a response to what the other party has done elsewhere.
segments.tr: يصف مؤيدو الخرائط الجديدة بأنها استخدام قانوني لسلطة الولاية أو رد على ما فعلته الحزب الآخر في مكان آخر.

segments.src: Critics say the timing and the openly political goals damage public trust.
segments.tr: يقول النقاد إن توقيت والأهداف السياسية المعلنة تضر بثقة الجمهور.

segments.src: Either way, the lines have drawn much more attention than they usually do outside a census year.
segments.tr: في كلتا الحالتين، حظيت الحدود باهتمام أكبر بكثير مما تحظى به عادة خارج سنة التعداد.

segments.src: ## Why a Few Seats Can Tip the House
segments.tr: ## لماذا يمكن لعدد قليل من المقاعد أن يحسم أغلبية المجلس

segments.src: The House majority is often decided by a very small number of seats.
segments.tr: غالباً ما يُحسم أغلبية مجلس النواب بعدد صغير جداً من المقاعد.

segments.src: A party needs 218 of 435 to hold a majority.
segments.tr: يحتاج الحزب إلى 218 مقعداً من أصل 435 للاحتفاظ بالأغلبية.

segments.src: In recent elections the margin between the parties has been narrow, sometimes only a handful of seats.
segments.tr: في الانتخابات الأخيرة، كانت الهامش بين الأحزاب ضيقاً، وأحياناً كان عبارة عن حفنة من المقاعد فقط.

segments.src: That has a few consequences:
segments.tr: هذا له عدة عواقب:

segments.src: 1. **Small shifts matter.** If a redrawn map turns even a few competitive districts into districts that lean clearly toward one party, the effect can be enough to change which party controls the chamber.
segments.tr: 1. **التحولات الصغيرة مهمة.** إذا قامت خريطة معاد رسمها بتحويل حتى عدد قليل من الدوائر التنافسية إلى دوائر تميل بوضوح نحو حزب واحد، فقد يكون التأثير كافياً لتغيير الحزب الذي يسيطر على الغرفة.

segments.src: 2. **Competitive seats are scarce.** Many districts already lean strongly toward one party, so control often comes down to a limited number of swing districts.
segments.tr: 2. **الدوائر التنافسية نادرة.** تميل العديد من الدوائر بالفعل بقوة نحو حزب واحد، لذا فإن السيطرة غالباً ما تؤول إلى عدد محدود من الدوائر المتأرجحة.

segments.src: 3. **Maps interact with the national mood.** A map can set the starting conditions, but it does not decide an election by itself. In a strong year for one party, seats drawn to favor the other can still flip. Analysts often call these "dummymanders" when a map built for an advantage does not hold up.
segments.tr: 3. **تتفاعل الخرائط مع المزاج الوطني.** يمكن للخريطة أن تحدد الظروف الأولية، لكنها لا تحسم الانتخابات بمفردها. في عام قوي لحزب ما، لا تزال المقاعد المرسومة لتفضيل الحزب الآخر قادرة على الانقلاب. غالباً ما يسمي المحللون هذه الحالات "دوميماندرز" عندما لا تصمد خريطة بُنيت لتحقيق ميزة.

segments.src: Because the stakes are so concentrated, a few new districts in a few states can attract as much attention as a national swing in voter opinion.
segments.tr: نظر لأن المخاطر مركزة للغاية، يمكن لعدد قليل من الدوائر الجديدة في بضع ولايات أن تجذب نفس القدر من الاتمام مثل التحول الوطني في آراء الناخبين.

segments.src: ## Gerrymandering, Defined
segments.tr: ## تعريف التلاعب بالدوائر الانتخابية

segments.src: Gerrymandering is the drawing of district lines to favor a political party, a group or an incumbent.
segments.tr: التلاعب بالدوائر الانتخابية هو رسم حدود الدوائر لتفضيل حزب سياسي أو مجموعة أو شاغل منصْب.

segments.src: Two common techniques are:
segments.tr: هناك تقنيتان شائعتان:

segments.src: - **Packing:** concentrating voters of one party into a small number of districts so that their votes are "wasted" on large winning margins.
segments.tr: - **الحشو (Packing):** تركيز ناخبي حزب واحد في عدد صغير من الدوائر بحيث يتم "إهدار" أصواتهم على هوامش فوز كبيرة.

segments.src: - **Cracking:** spreading voters of one party across several districts so that they fall short of a majority in each.
segments.tr: - **التكسير (Cracking):** نشر ناخبي حزب واحد عبر عدة دوائر بحيث يقصرون عن تحقيق أغلبية في كل منها.

segments.src: Both major parties have been accused of using these techniques, and each tends to defend its own maps as lawful while criticizing the other's.
segments.tr: تم اتهام كلا الحزبين الرئيسيين باستخدام هذه التقنيات، ويميل كل منهما إلى الدفاع عن خرائطه باعتبارها قانونية مع انتقاد خرائط الآخر.

segments.src: Researchers use measures such as the efficiency gap, the mean-median difference and computer-simulated map comparisons to estimate how much a map favors one side, though experts disagree about which measures are most reliable and about where acceptable line-drawing ends and gerrymandering begins.
segments.tr: يستخدم الباحثون مقاييس مثل فجوة الكفاءة والفرق بين المتوسط والوسيط ومقارنات الخرائط المحاكات بالحاسوب لتقدير مدى تفضيل الخريطة لطرف ما، على الرغم من اختلاف الخبراء حول المقاييس الأكثر موثوقية وحول المكان الذي تنتهي فيه عملية رسم الحدود المقبولة ويبدأ التلاعب.

segments.src: ## What Courts Have Said
segments.tr: ## ما قالت المحاكم

segments.src: Several landmark decisions shape what courts will and will not do.
segments.tr: تحدد عدة قرارات بارزة ما ستفعله المحاكم وما لن تفعله.

segments.src: - **Partisan gerrymandering and federal courts.** In *Rucho v. Common Cause* (2019), the Supreme Court held that claims of excessive partisan gerrymandering present political questions that federal courts cannot resolve. The Court noted that state courts and state law, as well as Congress, could still play a role.
segments.tr: - **التلاعب الحزبي بالدوائر والمحاكم الفيدرالية.** في قضية *Rucho v. Common Cause* (2019)، قضت المحكمة العليا بأن مزاعم التلاعب الحزبي المفرط تمثل أسئلة سياسية لا تستطيع المحاكم الفيدرالية حلها. وأشارت المحكمة إلى أن محاكم الولايات وقانون الولاية، فضلاً عن الكونغرس، لا يزال بإمكانهم لعب دور.

segments.src: - **Race and the Voting Rights Act.** In *Allen v. Milligan* (2023), the Court upheld the application of Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act to Alabama's congressional map, leaving in place a requirement to consider an additional district where minority voters could elect a candidate of their choice. Later litigation, including a case from Louisiana, has tested how far those protections extend and how they interact with the Constitution's limits on racial classifications.
segments.tr: - **العرق وقانون حقوق التصويت.** في قضية *Allen v. Milligan* (2023)، أيدت المحكمة تطبيق القسم 2 من قانون حقوق التصويت على خريطة الكونغرس في ألاباما، تاركة في مكانها مطلباً للنظر في دائرة إضافية حيث يمكن للناخبين من الأقليات انتخاب مرشح يختارونه. وقد اختبرت التقاضي اللاحق، بما في ذلك قضية من لويزيانا، مدى امتداد هذه الحماية وكيفية تفاعلها مع القيود الدستورية على التصنيفات العرقية.

segments.src: - **Separating race from party.** In *Alexander v. South Carolina State Conference of the NAACP* (2024), the Court emphasized that challengers must overcome a presumption that legislatures act in good faith and must account for the possibility that partisan goals, rather than racial ones, explain a district's shape.
segments.tr: - **فصل العرق عن الحزب.** في قضية *Alexander v. South Carolina State Conference of the NAACP* (2024)، أكدت المحكمة أن المعترضين يجب أن يتغلبوا على افتراض أن المجالس التشريعية تتصرف بحسن نية ويجب أن يأخذوا في الاعتبار احتمال أن تكون الأهداف الحزبية، وليس العرقية، هي ما يفسر شكل الدائرة.

segments.src: - **State courts.** In *Moore v. Harper* (2023), the Court rejected a broad version of the "independent state legislature" theory, confirming that state courts may review congressional maps under their state constitutions. As a result, many of the most consequential map disputes are decided under state law.
segments.tr: - **محاكم الولايات.** في قضية *Moore v. Harper* (2023)، رفضت المحكمة نسخة واسعة من نظرية "الهيئة التشريعية المستقلة للولاية"، مؤكدة أن محاكم الولايات يمكنها مراجعة خرائط الكونغرس بموجب دساتير ولاياتهم. ونتيجة لذلك، يتم حل العديد من نزاعات الخرائط الأكثر أهمية بموجب قانون الولاية.

segments.src: - **Timing of challenges.** Federal courts have also been reluctant to change maps close to an election. The Court has cited concerns about voter confusion and administrative burden, an idea often called the Purcell principle, when letting maps stay in place while lawsuits continue.
segments.tr: - **توقيت الطعون.** كانت المحاكم الفيدرالية مترددة أيضاً في تغيير الخرائط بالقرب من موعد الانتخابات. استشهدت المحكمة بمخاوف بشأن ارتباك الناخبين والعبء الإداري، وهي فكرة غالباً ما تسمى مبدأ بورسيل، عند السماح للخرائط بالبقاء في مكانها بينما تستمر الدعاوى القضائية.

segments.src: Taken together, these rulings mean that the main checks on partisan map drawing now come from state constitutions, state courts, ballot measures and the voters themselves, rather than from federal courts.
segments.tr: باختصار، تعني هذه الأحكام أن الضوابط الرئيسية على رسم الخرائط الحزبية تأتي الآن من دساتير الولايات، ومحاكم الولايات، وتدابير الاقتراع، والناخبين أنفسهم، وليس من المحاكم الفيدرالية.

segments.src: Racial discrimination claims under the Voting Rights Act and the Constitution remain a federal avenue, but the legal standards are still being refined.
segments.tr: تظل مزاعم التمييز العرقي بموجب قانون حقوق التصويت والدستور مساراً فدرالياً، لكن المعايير القانونية لا تزال قيد التحسين.

segments.src: ## The Role of Voters and Ballot Measures
segments.tr: ## دور الناخبين وإجراءات الاقتراع

segments.src: In several states, voters have been asked to weigh in directly.
segments.tr: في عدة ولايات، طُلب من الناخبين الإدلاء بأرائهم مباشرة.

segments.src: Past ballot measures created independent commissions in states such as California, Michigan and Colorado.
segments.tr: أنشأت تدابير الاقتراع السابقة لجانًا مستقلة في ولايات مثل كاليفورنيا وميشيغان وكولورادو.

segments.src: More recently, mid-decade fights have included proposals that would temporarily suspend or change those arrangements in response to maps drawn elsewhere.
segments.tr: في الآونة الأخيرة، تضمنت صراعات منتصف العقد مقترحات من شأنها تعليق أو تغيير تلك الترتيبات مؤقتاً استجابة للخرائط المرسومة في مكان آخر.

segments.src: Supporters say such measures give voters a say in how the rules apply.
segments.tr: يقول المؤيدون إن مثل هذه التدابير تمنح الناخبين رأياً في كيفية تطبيق القواعد.

segments.src: Opponents say they undercut the reforms voters previously approved.
segments.tr: يقول المعارضون إنها تقوض الإصلاحات التي وافق عليها الناخبون سابقاً.

segments.src: These debates show how the question has shifted from "who should draw the lines" to "when, and under what rules."
segments.tr: تظهر هذه النقاشات كيف تحول السؤال من "من يجب أن يرسم الحدود" إلى "متى، وتحت أي قواعد."

segments.src: ## What to Watch
segments.tr: ## ما يجب مراقبته

segments.src: For readers following the story, a few practical points help in sorting out claims and counterclaims:
segments.tr: بالنسبة للقراء الذين يتابعون القصة، تساعد عدة نقاط عمليّة في فرز الادعاءات والادعاءات المضادة:

segments.src: - **Check the status of each map.** A map passed by a legislature may be challenged in court, blocked, modified or approved. Whether it is used in a given election depends on the final outcome and the calendar.
segments.tr: - **تحقق من حالة كل خريطة.** قد يتم الطعن في خريطة أقرها المجلس التشريعي في المحكمة، أو حظرها، أو تعديلها، أو الموافقة عليها. ما إذا كانت تُستخدم في انتخابات معينة يعتمد على النتيجة النهائية والتقويم.

segments.src: - **Look at candidate filing deadlines and primaries.** Courts are more reluctant to disrupt maps once the election process is underway.
segments.tr: - **انظر إلى المواعيد النهائية لتقديم المرشحين والانتخابات التمهيدية.** المحاكم أكثر ترددًا في تعطيل الخرائط بمجرد أن تبدأ عملية الانتخابات.

segments.src: - **Compare proposed districts with past results.** Local election data show how competitive a new district is likely to be, but turnout and the national environment can change the outcome.
segments.tr: - **قارن الدوائر المقترحة بالنتائج السابقة.** تظهر بيانات الانتخابات المحلية مدى تنافسية الدائرة الجديدة التي يحتمل أن تكون عليها، لكن نسبة المشاركة والبيئة الوطنية يمكن أن تغيرا النتيجة.

segments.src: - **Separate legal questions from political ones.** A map can be legal and still controversial, or it can be popular with one party and unpopular with the other. Courts typically address only the legal question.
segments.tr: - **افصل الأسئلة القانونية عن السياسية.** يمكن أن تكون الخريطة قانونية ولا تزال مثيرة للجدل، أو يمكن أن تكون شائعة لدى حزب واحد وغير شعبية لدى الحزب الآخر. عادة ما تتعامل المحاكم مع السؤال القانوني فقط.

segments.src: - **Consult official sources.** State election offices, court filings and nonpartisan trackers publish current maps and rulings.
segments.tr: - **استشر المصادر الرسمية.** تنشر مكاتب الانتخابات بالولاية وملفات المحاكم والمتتبعين غير الحزبيين الخرائط والأحكام الحالية.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

fr.title: Redessiner la carte en milieu de décennie : comment les batailles sur les districts congressionnels pourraient décider du contrôle de la Chambre

segments.src: Congressional district maps are usually redrawn once every ten years, after the census.
segments.tr: Les cartes des districts congressionnels sont généralement redessinées une fois tous les dix ans, après le recensement.

segments.src: In this cycle, several states have taken the unusual step of redrawing lines in the middle of the decade.
segments.tr: Dans ce cycle, plusieurs États ont pris la décision inhabituelle de redessiner les limites au milieu de la décennie.

segments.src: Lawmakers, governors, voters and judges are all part of the argument, and the maps themselves have become a campaign story.
segments.tr: Législateurs, gouverneurs, électeurs et juges font tous partie du débat, et les cartes elles-mêmes sont devenues un sujet de campagne.

segments.src: This explainer covers how redistricting works, why a handful of seats can matter so much, and what courts have said so far.
segments.tr: Cette explication aborde le fonctionnement du redécoupage électoral, pourquoi une poignée de sièges peut avoir autant d'importance, et ce que les tribunaux ont déclaré jusqu'à présent.

segments.src: ## How Redistricting Normally Works
segments.tr: ## Comment fonctionne normalement le redécoupage électoral

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: La Chambre des représentants des États-Unis

segments.src: House has 435 voting seats.
segments.tr: compte 435 sièges avec droit de vote.

segments.src: Each state's share of those seats depends on its population, which the Constitution requires the federal government to count every ten years.
segments.tr: La part de ces sièges de chaque État dépend de sa population, que la Constitution oblige le gouvernement fédéral à compter tous les dix ans.

segments.src: After each census, seats are reapportioned among the states.
segments.tr: Après chaque recensement, les sièges sont répartis entre les États.

segments.src: Each state then draws the boundaries for its own congressional districts.
segments.tr: Chaque État trace ensuite les frontières de ses propres districts congressionnels.

segments.src: Who draws those lines depends on the state:
segments.tr: Qui trace ces limites dépend de l'État :

segments.src: - **State legislatures** draw the maps in most states. The governor can often sign or veto the plan.
segments.tr: - **Les législatures d'État** dessinent les cartes dans la plupart des États. Le gouverneur peut souvent signer ou opposer son veto au plan.

segments.src: - **Independent or bipartisan commissions** draw the maps in a smaller group of states, including California, Colorado, Michigan and Arizona. The rules for these commissions vary widely.
segments.tr: - **Les commissions indépendantes ou bipartisanes** dessinent les cartes dans un groupe plus restreint d'États, notamment la Californie, le Colorado, le Michigan et l'Arizona. Les règles de ces commissions varient considérablement.

segments.src: - **Courts** sometimes step in and draw or adopt a map when the political branches cannot agree or when a map is struck down.
segments.tr: - **Les tribunaux** interviennent parfois et dessinent ou adoptent une carte lorsque les branches politiques ne parviennent pas à s'entendre ou lorsqu'une carte est invalidée.

segments.src: Districts must contain roughly equal populations, and they must comply with the Voting Rights Act, which restricts maps that unlawfully weaken the voting strength of racial or language minority groups.
segments.tr: Les districts doivent contenir des populations à peu près égales et doivent respecter la loi sur les droits de vote (Voting Rights Act), qui restreint les cartes affaiblissant illégalement la force électorale des groupes minoritaires raciaux ou linguistiques.

segments.src: Many states add their own rules, such as requiring compact or contiguous districts or keeping counties and communities together.
segments.tr: De nombreux États ajoutent leurs propres règles, comme l'obligation d'avoir des districts compacts ou contigus ou de maintenir ensemble les comtés et les communautés.

segments.src: ## Why "Mid-Decade" Redistricting Is Unusual
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi le redécoupage électoral en « milieu de décennie » est inhabituel

segments.src: Nothing in federal law bars a state from drawing new congressional lines between censuses.
segments.tr: Rien dans la loi fédérale n'interdit à un État de tracer de nouvelles frontières congressionnelles entre les recensements.

segments.src: In practice it has been uncommon, because the new census is meant to be the natural reset point.
segments.tr: Dans la pratique, cela a été peu courant, car le nouveau recensement est censé être le point de réinitialisation naturel.

segments.src: Some states restrict mid-decade changes in their constitutions or statutes, and others do not.
segments.tr: Certains États restreignent les changements en milieu de décennie dans leurs constitutions ou statuts, et d'autres non.

segments.src: There are precedents.
segments.tr: Il y a des précédents.

segments.src: Texas redrew its congressional map in 2003, and the Supreme Court later reviewed parts of that plan in *LULAC v.
segments.tr: Le Texas a redessiné sa carte congressionnelle en 2003, et la Cour suprême a ensuite examiné des parties de ce plan dans l'affaire *LULAC v.

segments.src: What has changed in this cycle is the scale and the back-and-forth nature of the effort.
segments.tr: Ce qui a changé dans ce cycle, c'est l'ampleur et la nature de va-et-vient de l'effort.

segments.src: Moves in one state have been publicly tied to responses in others.
segments.tr: Les actions dans un État ont été publiquement liées aux réponses dans d'autres.

segments.src: Supporters of the new maps describe them as a lawful use of a state's authority or a response to what the other party has done elsewhere.
segments.tr: Les partisans des nouvelles cartes les décrivent comme une utilisation légitime de l'autorité d'un État ou comme une réponse à ce que l'autre parti a fait ailleurs.

segments.src: Critics say the timing and the openly political goals damage public trust.
segments.tr: Les critiques affirment que le calendrier et les objectifs ouvertement politiques nuisent à la confiance du public.

segments.src: Either way, the lines have drawn much more attention than they usually do outside a census year.
segments.tr: Quoi qu'il en soit, les limites ont attiré beaucoup plus d'attention qu'elles ne le font habituellement en dehors d'une année de recensement.

segments.src: ## Why a Few Seats Can Tip the House
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi quelques sièges peuvent faire basculer la Chambre

segments.src: The House majority is often decided by a very small number of seats.
segments.tr: La majorité à la Chambre est souvent décidée par un très petit nombre de sièges.

segments.src: A party needs 218 of 435 to hold a majority.
segments.tr: Un parti a besoin de 218 sièges sur 435 pour détenir la majorité.

segments.src: In recent elections the margin between the parties has been narrow, sometimes only a handful of seats.
segments.tr: Lors des récentes élections, la marge entre les partis a été étroite, parfois seulement une poignée de sièges.

segments.src: That has a few consequences:
segments.tr: Cela a quelques conséquences :

segments.src: 1. **Small shifts matter.** If a redrawn map turns even a few competitive districts into districts that lean clearly toward one party, the effect can be enough to change which party controls the chamber.
segments.tr: 1. **Les petits changements comptent.** Si une carte redessinée transforme même quelques districts compétitifs en districts qui penchent clairement vers un parti, l'effet peut suffire à changer le parti qui contrôle la chambre.

segments.src: 2. **Competitive seats are scarce.** Many districts already lean strongly toward one party, so control often comes down to a limited number of swing districts.
segments.tr: 2. **Les districts compétitifs sont rares.** De nombreux districts penchent déjà fortement vers un parti, de sorte que le contrôle se résume souvent à un nombre limité de districts bascules.

segments.src: 3. **Maps interact with the national mood.** A map can set the starting conditions, but it does not decide an election by itself. In a strong year for one party, seats drawn to favor the other can still flip. Analysts often call these "dummymanders" when a map built for an advantage does not hold up.
segments.tr: 3. **Les cartes interagissent avec l'humeur nationale.** Une carte peut définir les conditions de départ, mais elle ne décide pas d'une élection à elle seule. Lors d'une année forte pour un parti, les sièges dessinés pour favoriser l'autre peuvent toujours basculer. Les analystes appellent souvent ces cas des « dummymanders » lorsqu'une carte conçue pour un avantage ne tient pas.

segments.src: Because the stakes are so concentrated, a few new districts in a few states can attract as much attention as a national swing in voter opinion.
segments.tr: Les enjeux étant si concentrés, quelques nouveaux districts dans quelques États peuvent attirer autant d'attention qu'une bascule nationale dans l'opinion des électeurs.

segments.src: ## Gerrymandering, Defined
segments.tr: ## Le charcutage électoral (Gerrymandering), défini

segments.src: Gerrymandering is the drawing of district lines to favor a political party, a group or an incumbent.
segments.tr: Le charcutage électoral est le tracé des limites des districts pour favoriser un parti politique, un groupe ou un sortant.

segments.src: Two common techniques are:
segments.tr: Deux techniques courantes sont :

segments.src: - **Packing:** concentrating voters of one party into a small number of districts so that their votes are "wasted" on large winning margins.
segments.tr: - **La concentration (Packing) :** concentrer les électeurs d'un parti dans un petit nombre de districts afin que leurs votes soient « gaspillés » sur de larges marges de victoire.

segments.src: - **Cracking:** spreading voters of one party across several districts so that they fall short of a majority in each.
segments.tr: - **La dispersion (Cracking) :** répartir les électeurs d'un parti dans plusieurs districts afin qu'ils n'atteignent pas la majorité dans chacun d'eux.

segments.src: Both major parties have been accused of using these techniques, and each tends to defend its own maps as lawful while criticizing the other's.
segments.tr: Les deux grands partis ont été accusés d'utiliser ces techniques, et chacun a tendance à défendre ses propres cartes comme étant légales tout en critiquant celles de l'autre.

segments.src: Researchers use measures such as the efficiency gap, the mean-median difference and computer-simulated map comparisons to estimate how much a map favors one side, though experts disagree about which measures are most reliable and about where acceptable line-drawing ends and gerrymandering begins.
segments.tr: Les chercheurs utilisent des mesures telles que l'écart d'efficacité (efficiency gap), la différence moyenne-médiane et des comparaisons de cartes simulées par ordinateur pour estimer dans quelle mesure une carte favorise un camp, bien que les experts ne soient pas d'accord sur les mesures les plus fiables et sur le point où s'arrête le tracé de lignes acceptable et où commence le charcutage électoral.

segments.src: ## What Courts Have Said
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'ont dit les tribunaux

segments.src: Several landmark decisions shape what courts will and will not do.
segments.tr: Plusieurs décisions historiques façonnent ce que les tribunaux feront et ne feront pas.

segments.src: - **Partisan gerrymandering and federal courts.** In *Rucho v. Common Cause* (2019), the Supreme Court held that claims of excessive partisan gerrymandering present political questions that federal courts cannot resolve. The Court noted that state courts and state law, as well as Congress, could still play a role.
segments.tr: - **Le charcutage électoral partisan et les tribunaux fédéraux.** Dans l'affaire *Rucho v. Common Cause* (2019), la Cour suprême a jugé que les allégations de charcutage électoral partisan excessif soulèvent des questions politiques que les tribunaux fédéraux ne peuvent pas résoudre. La Cour a noté que les tribunaux étatiques et le droit des États, ainsi que le Congrès, pouvaient toujours jouer un rôle.

segments.src: - **Race and the Voting Rights Act.** In *Allen v. Milligan* (2023), the Court upheld the application of Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act to Alabama's congressional map, leaving in place a requirement to consider an additional district where minority voters could elect a candidate of their choice. Later litigation, including a case from Louisiana, has tested how far those protections extend and how they interact with the Constitution's limits on racial classifications.
segments.tr: - **La race et la loi sur les droits de vote (Voting Rights Act).** Dans l'affaire *Allen v. Milligan* (2023), la Cour a confirmé l'application de l'article 2 de la loi sur les droits de vote à la carte congressionnelle de l'Alabama, maintenant en place l'obligation d'envisager un district supplémentaire où les électeurs minoritaires pourraient élire un candidat de leur choix. Un contentieux ultérieur, incluant une affaire de la Louisiane, a testé jusqu'où ces protections s'étendent et comment elles interagissent avec les limites de la Constitution sur les classifications raciales.

segments.src: - **Separating race from party.** In *Alexander v. South Carolina State Conference of the NAACP* (2024), the Court emphasized that challengers must overcome a presumption that legislatures act in good faith and must account for the possibility that partisan goals, rather than racial ones, explain a district's shape.
segments.tr: - **Séparer la race du parti.** Dans l'affaire *Alexander v. South Carolina State Conference of the NAACP* (2024), la Cour a souligné que les contestataires doivent surmonter la présomption que les législatures agissent de bonne foi et doivent tenir compte de la possibilité que des objectifs partisans, plutôt que raciaux, expliquent la forme d'un district.

segments.src: - **State courts.** In *Moore v. Harper* (2023), the Court rejected a broad version of the "independent state legislature" theory, confirming that state courts may review congressional maps under their state constitutions. As a result, many of the most consequential map disputes are decided under state law.
segments.tr: - **Les tribunaux d'État.** Dans l'affaire *Moore v. Harper* (2023), la Cour a rejeté une version large de la théorie de la « législature d'État indépendante », confirmant que les tribunaux d'État peuvent examiner les cartes congressionnelles en vertu de leur constitution d'État. En conséquence, nombre des litiges cartographiques les plus lourds de conséquences sont tranchés en vertu du droit des États.

segments.src: - **Timing of challenges.** Federal courts have also been reluctant to change maps close to an election. The Court has cited concerns about voter confusion and administrative burden, an idea often called the Purcell principle, when letting maps stay in place while lawsuits continue.
segments.tr: - **Le calendrier des contestations.** Les tribunaux fédéraux ont également hésité à modifier les cartes à l'approche d'une élection. La Cour a invoqué des préoccupations concernant la confusion des électeurs et la charge administrative, une idée souvent appelée le principe de Purcell, en laissant les cartes en place pendant que les poursuites se poursuivent.

segments.src: Taken together, these rulings mean that the main checks on partisan map drawing now come from state constitutions, state courts, ballot measures and the voters themselves, rather than from federal courts.
segments.tr: Prises ensemble, ces décisions signifient que les principaux contrôles sur le tracé des cartes partisanes proviennent désormais des constitutions des États, des tribunaux d'État, des initiatives électorales et des électeurs eux-mêmes, plutôt que des tribunaux fédéraux.

segments.src: Racial discrimination claims under the Voting Rights Act and the Constitution remain a federal avenue, but the legal standards are still being refined.
segments.tr: Les allégations de discrimination raciale en vertu de la loi sur les droits de vote et de la Constitution restent une voie fédérale, mais les normes juridiques sont encore en cours d'affinage.

segments.src: ## The Role of Voters and Ballot Measures
segments.tr: ## Le rôle des électeurs et des initiatives électorales

segments.src: In several states, voters have been asked to weigh in directly.
segments.tr: Dans plusieurs États, les électeurs ont été invités à se prononcer directement.

segments.src: Past ballot measures created independent commissions in states such as California, Michigan and Colorado.
segments.tr: Les initiatives électorales passées ont créé des commissions indépendantes dans des États tels que la Californie, le Michigan et le Colorado.

segments.src: More recently, mid-decade fights have included proposals that would temporarily suspend or change those arrangements in response to maps drawn elsewhere.
segments.tr: Plus récemment, les luttes de milieu de décennie ont inclus des propositions qui suspendrait temporairement ou modifieraient ces arrangements en réponse aux cartes tracées ailleurs.

segments.src: Supporters say such measures give voters a say in how the rules apply.
segments.tr: Les partisans affirment que de telles mesures donnent aux électeurs leur mot à dire sur la façon dont les règles s'appliquent.

segments.src: Opponents say they undercut the reforms voters previously approved.
segments.tr: Les opposants affirment qu'elles sapent les réformes que les électeurs ont approuvées auparavant.

segments.src: These debates show how the question has shifted from "who should draw the lines" to "when, and under what rules."
segments.tr: Ces débats montrent comment la question est passée de « qui devrait tracer les lignes » à « quand et selon quelles règles ».

segments.src: ## What to Watch
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut surveiller

segments.src: For readers following the story, a few practical points help in sorting out claims and counterclaims:
segments.tr: Pour les lecteurs qui suivent l'histoire, quelques points pratiques aident à trier les réclamations et les contre-réclamations :

segments.src: - **Check the status of each map.** A map passed by a legislature may be challenged in court, blocked, modified or approved. Whether it is used in a given election depends on the final outcome and the calendar.
segments.tr: - **Vérifiez le statut de chaque carte.** Une carte adoptée par une législature peut être contestée devant les tribunaux, bloquée, modifiée ou approuvée. Le fait qu'elle soit utilisée lors d'une élection donnée dépend du résultat final et du calendrier.

segments.src: - **Look at candidate filing deadlines and primaries.** Courts are more reluctant to disrupt maps once the election process is underway.
segments.tr: - **Examinez les délais de dépôt des candidatures et les primaires.** Les tribunaux sont plus réticents à perturber les cartes une fois que le processus électoral est en cours.

segments.src: - **Compare proposed districts with past results.** Local election data show how competitive a new district is likely to be, but turnout and the national environment can change the outcome.
segments.tr: - **Comparez les districts proposés avec les résultats passés.** Les données électorales locales montrent à quel point un nouveau district est susceptible d'être compétitif, mais la participation et l'environnement national peuvent modifier le résultat.

segments.src: - **Separate legal questions from political ones.** A map can be legal and still controversial, or it can be popular with one party and unpopular with the other. Courts typically address only the legal question.
segments.tr: - **Séparez les questions juridiques des questions politiques.** Une carte peut être légale tout en restant controversée, ou elle peut être populaire auprès d'un parti et impopulaire auprès de l'autre. Les tribunaux ne traitent généralement que la question juridique.

segments.src: - **Consult official sources.** State election offices, court filings and nonpartisan trackers publish current maps and rulings.
segments.tr: - **Consultez les sources officielles.** Les bureaux électoraux des États, les dossiers judiciaires et les traqueurs non partisans publient les cartes et les décisions actuelles.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## L'essentiel

segments.src: District lines determine how votes become seats, and in a closely divided House, a few redrawn districts can have an outsized effect.
segments.tr: Les limites des districts déterminent comment les votes deviennent des sièges, et dans une Chambre divisée de près, quelques districts redessinés peuvent avoir un effet démesuré.

segments.src: The current wave of mid-decade redistricting has pushed a technical, normally once-a-decade process into the center of the campaign.
segments.tr: La vague actuelle de redécoupage en milieu de décennie a poussé un processus technique, normalement quinquennal, au centre de la campagne.

segments.src: Courts have drawn some boundaries around what is allowed, especially on race, while leaving much of the question of partisan advantage to states and voters.
segments.tr: Les tribunaux ont tracé des limites sur ce qui est permis, en particulier sur la race, tout en laissant une grande partie de la question de l'avantage partisan aux États et aux électeurs.

segments.src: Readers who want to understand the stakes in their own state should look up their current district, find out who drew it and under what rules, and follow how any legal challenges are resolved before Election Day.
segments.tr: Les lecteurs qui veulent comprendre les enjeux dans leur propre État devraient consulter leur district actuel, découvrir qui l'a dessiné et selon quelles règles, et suivre la manière dont les contestations juridiques sont résolues avant le jour du scrutin.

segments.src: What has changed in this cycle is the scale and the back-and-forth nature of the effort.

segments.src: Moves in one state have been publicly tied to responses in others.

segments.src: Either way, the lines have drawn much more attention than they usually do outside a census year.
segments.tr: De qualquer forma, as linhas atraíram muito mais atenção do que o habitual fora de um ano de censo.

segments.src: ## Why a Few Seats Can Tip the House
segments.tr: ## Por Que Poucos Assentos Podem Inclinar a Câmara

segments.src: The House majority is often decided by a very small number of seats.
segments.tr: A maioria da Câmara é frequentemente decidida por um número muito pequeno de assentos.

segments.src: A party needs 218 of 435 to hold a majority.
segments.tr: Um partido precisa de 218 de 435 para manter a maioria.

segments.src: In recent elections the margin between the parties has been narrow, sometimes only a handful of seats.
segments.tr: Em eleições recentes, a margem entre os partidos tem sido estreita, às vezes apenas um punhado de assentos.

segments.src: That has a few consequences:
segments.tr: Isso tem algumas consequências:

segments.src: 1. **Small shifts matter.** If a redrawn map turns even a few competitive districts into districts that lean clearly toward one party, the effect can be enough to change which party controls the chamber.
segments.tr: 1. **Pequenas mudanças importam.** Se um mapa redesenhado transformar até mesmo alguns distritos competitivos em distritos que tendem claramente para um partido, o efeito pode ser suficiente para mudar qual partido controla a câmara.

segments.src: 2. **Competitive seats are scarce.** Many districts already lean strongly toward one party, so control often comes down to a limited number of swing districts.
segments.tr: 2. **Distritos competitivos são escassos.** Muitos distritos já tendem fortemente para um partido, então o controle frequentemente se resume a um número limitado de distritos flutuantes.

segments.src: 3. **Maps interact with the national mood.** A map can set the starting conditions, but it does not decide an election by itself. In a strong year for one party, seats drawn to favor the other can still flip. Analysts often call these "dummymanders" when a map built for an advantage does not hold up.
segments.tr: 3. **Mapas interagem com o clima nacional.** Um mapa pode definir as condições iniciais, mas não decide uma eleição por si só. Em um ano forte para um partido, assentos desenhados para favorecer o outro ainda podem virar. Analistas frequentemente chamam isso de "dummymanders" quando um mapa construído para uma vantagem não se sustenta.

segments.src: Because the stakes are so concentrated, a few new districts in a few states can attract as much attention as a national swing in voter opinion.
segments.tr: Como os riscos estão tão concentrados, alguns novos distritos em alguns estados podem atrair tanta atenção quanto uma oscilação nacional na opinião dos eleitores.

segments.src: ## Gerrymandering, Defined
segments.tr: ## Gerrymandering, Definido

segments.src: Gerrymandering is the drawing of district lines to favor a political party, a group or an incumbent.
segments.tr: Gerrymandering é o desenho de limites de distritos para favorecer um partido político, um grupo ou um ocupante de cargo.

segments.src: Two common techniques are:
segments.tr: Duas técnicas comuns são:

segments.src: - **Packing:** concentrating voters of one party into a small number of districts so that their votes are "wasted" on large winning margins.
segments.tr: - **Empacotamento:** concentrar eleitores de um partido em um pequeno número de votos para que seus votos sejam "desperdiçados" em grandes margens de vitória.

segments.src: - **Cracking:** spreading voters of one party across several districts so that they fall short of a majority in each.
segments.tr: - **Fracionamento:** espalhar eleitores de um partido por vários distritos para que fiquem aquém de uma maioria em cada um.

segments.src: Both major parties have been accused of using these techniques, and each tends to defend its own maps as lawful while criticizing the other's.
segments.tr: Ambos os principais partidos foram acusados de usar essas técnicas, e cada um tende a defender seus próprios mapas como legais enquanto critica os do outro.

segments.src: Researchers use measures such as the efficiency gap, the mean-median difference and computer-simulated map comparisons to estimate how much a map favors one side, though experts disagree about which measures are most reliable and about where acceptable line-drawing ends and gerrymandering begins.
segments.tr: Pesquisadores usam medidas como a lacuna de eficiência, a diferença entre média e mediana e comparações de mapas simuladas por computador para estimar quanto um mapa favorece um lado, embora especialistas discordem sobre quais medidas são mais confiáveis e sobre onde termina o desenho aceitável de linhas e começa o gerrymandering.

segments.src: ## What Courts Have Said
segments.tr: ## O Que os Tribunais Disseram

segments.src: Several landmark decisions shape what courts will and will not do.
segments.tr: Várias decisões históricas moldam o que os tribunais farão e não farão.

segments.src: - **Partisan gerrymandering and federal courts.** In *Rucho v. Common Cause* (2019), the Supreme Court held that claims of excessive partisan gerrymandering present political questions that federal courts cannot resolve. The Court noted that state courts and state law, as well as Congress, could still play a role.
segments.tr: - **Gerrymandering partidário e tribunais federais.** Em *Rucho v. Common Cause* (2019), a Suprema Corte decidiu que alegações de gerrymandering partidário excessivo apresentam questões políticas que os tribunais federais não podem resolver. A Corte observou que os tribunais estaduais e a lei estadual, bem como o Congresso, ainda podiam desempenhar um papel.

segments.src: - **Race and the Voting Rights Act.** In *Allen v. Milligan* (2023), the Court upheld the application of Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act to Alabama's congressional map, leaving in place a requirement to consider an additional district where minority voters could elect a candidate of their choice. Later litigation, including a case from Louisiana, has tested how far those protections extend and how they interact with the Constitution's limits on racial classifications.
segments.tr: - **Raça e a Lei de Direitos de Voto.** Em *Allen v. Milligan* (2023), a Corte confirmou a aplicação da Seção 2 da Lei de Direitos de Voto ao mapa congressional do Alabama, mantendo em vigor o requisito de considerar um distrito adicional onde eleitores minoritários pudessem eleger um candidato de sua escolha. Litígios posteriores, incluindo um caso da Louisiana, testaram até onde essas proteções se estendem e como interagem com os limites da Constituição sobre classificações raciais.

segments.src: - **Separating race from party.** In *Alexander v. South Carolina State Conference of the NAACP* (2024), the Court emphasized that challengers must overcome a presumption that legislatures act in good faith and must account for the possibility that partisan goals, rather than racial ones, explain a district's shape.
segments.tr: - **Separando raça de partido.** Em *Alexander v. South Carolina State Conference of the NAACP* (2024), a Corte enfatizou que os desafiantes devem superar uma presunção de que as legislaturas agem de boa-fé e devem dar conta da possibilidade de que objetivos partidários, em vez de raciais, expliquem a forma de um distrito.

segments.src: - **State courts.** In *Moore v. Harper* (2023), the Court rejected a broad version of the "independent state legislature" theory, confirming that state courts may review congressional maps under their state constitutions. As a result, many of the most consequential map disputes are decided under state law.
segments.tr: - **Tribunais estaduais.** Em *Moore v. Harper* (2023), a Corte rejeitou uma versão ampla da teoria da "legislatura estadual independente", confirmando que os tribunais estaduais podem revisar mapas congressionais sob suas constituições estaduais. Como resultado, muitas das disputas de mapas mais consequentes são decididas sob a lei estadual.

segments.src: - **Timing of challenges.** Federal courts have also been reluctant to change maps close to an election. The Court has cited concerns about voter confusion and administrative burden, an idea often called the Purcell principle, when letting maps stay in place while lawsuits continue.
segments.tr: - **Momento dos desafios.** Os tribunais federais também têm relutado em alterar mapas perto de uma eleição. A Corte citou preocupações sobre confusão dos eleitores e ônus administrativo, uma ideia frequentemente chamada de princípio de Purcell, ao permitir que os mapas permaneçam no lugar enquanto os processos continuam.

segments.src: Taken together, these rulings mean that the main checks on partisan map drawing now come from state constitutions, state courts, ballot measures and the voters themselves, rather than from federal courts.
segments.tr: Consideradas em conjunto, essas decisões significam que os principais controles sobre o desenho partidário de mapas agora vêm de constituições estaduais, tribunais estaduais, medidas eleitorais e dos próprios eleitores, em vez de tribunais federais.

segments.src: Racial discrimination claims under the Voting Rights Act and the Constitution remain a federal avenue, but the legal standards are still being refined.
segments.tr: Alegações de discriminação racial sob a Lei de Direitos de Voto e a Constituição continuam sendo um caminho federal, mas os padrões legais ainda estão sendo refinados.

segments.src: ## The Role of Voters and Ballot Measures
segments.tr: ## O Papel dos Eleitores e das Medidas Eleitorais

segments.src: In several states, voters have been asked to weigh in directly.
segments.tr: Em vários estados, os eleitores foram convidados a opinar diretamente.

segments.src: Past ballot measures created independent commissions in states such as California, Michigan and Colorado.
segments.tr: Medidas eleitorais passadas criaram comissões independentes em estados como Califórnia, Michigan e Colorado.

segments.src: More recently, mid-decade fights have included proposals that would temporarily suspend or change those arrangements in response to maps drawn elsewhere.
segments.tr: Mais recentemente, lutas de meio de década incluíram propostas que suspenderiam ou alterariam temporariamente esses arranjos em resposta a mapas desenhados em outros lugares.

segments.src: Supporters say such measures give voters a say in how the rules apply.
segments.tr: Apoiadores dizem que tais medidas dão aos eleitores uma voz em como as regras se aplicam.

segments.src: Opponents say they undercut the reforms voters previously approved.
segments.tr: Opositores dizem que elas minam as reformas que os eleitores aprovaram anteriormente.

segments.src: These debates show how the question has shifted from "who should draw the lines" to "when, and under what rules."
segments.tr: Esses debates mostram como a questão mudou de "quem deve desenhar as linhas" para "quando e sob quais regras."

segments.src: ## What to Watch
segments.tr: ## O Que Observar

segments.src: For readers following the story, a few practical points help in sorting out claims and counterclaims:
segments.tr: Para leitores que acompanham a história, alguns pontos práticos ajudam a separar alegações e contra-alegações:

segments.src: - **Check the status of each map.** A map passed by a legislature may be challenged in court, blocked, modified or approved. Whether it is used in a given election depends on the final outcome and the calendar.
segments.tr: - **Verifique o status de cada mapa.** Um mapa aprovado por uma legislatura pode ser contestado no tribunal, bloqueado, modificado ou aprovado. Se ele é usado em uma dada eleição depende do resultado final e do calendário.

segments.src: - **Look at candidate filing deadlines and primaries.** Courts are more reluctant to disrupt maps once the election process is underway.
segments.tr: - **Olhe para os prazos de registro de candidatos e primárias.** Os tribunais relutam mais em perturbar mapas uma vez que o processo eleitoral está em andamento.

segments.src: - **Compare proposed districts with past results.** Local election data show how competitive a new district is likely to be, but turnout and the national environment can change the outcome.
segments.tr: - **Compare os distritos propostos com resultados passados.** Dados eleitorais locais mostram quão competitivo um novo distrito provavelmente será, mas a participação e o ambiente nacional podem mudar o resultado.

segments.src: - **Separate legal questions from political ones.** A map can be legal and still controversial, or it can be popular with one party and unpopular with the other. Courts typically address only the legal question.
segments.tr: - **Separe questões legais de políticas.** Um mapa pode ser legal e ainda controverso, ou pode ser popular com um partido e impopular com o outro. Os tribunais tipicamente abordam apenas a questão legal.

segments.src: - **Consult official sources.** State election offices, court filings and nonpartisan trackers publish current maps and rulings.
segments.tr: - **Consulte fontes oficiais.** Escritórios eleitorais estaduais, petições judiciais e rastreadores não partidários publicam mapas atuais e decisões.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## O Conclusão

segments.src: District lines determine how votes become seats, and in a closely divided House, a few redrawn districts can have an outsized effect.
segments.tr: As linhas dos distritos determinam como os votos se tornam assentos, e em uma Câmara dividida por pouco, alguns distritos redesenhados podem ter um efeito descomunal.

segments.src: The current wave of mid-decade redistricting has pushed a technical, normally once-a-decade process into the center of the campaign.
segments.tr: A onda atual de redistritagem de meio de década empurrou um processo técnico, normalmente realizado uma vez a cada década, para o centro da campanha.

segments.src: Courts have drawn some boundaries around what is allowed, especially on race, while leaving much of the question of partisan advantage to states and voters.
segments.tr: Os tribunais traçaram alguns limites sobre o que é permitido, especialmente sobre raça, enquanto deixam grande parte da questão da vantagem partidária para estados e eleitores.

segments.src: Readers who want to understand the stakes in their own state should look up their current district, find out who drew it and under what rules, and follow how any legal challenges are resolved before Election Day.
segments.tr: Leitores que querem entender os riscos em seu próprio estado devem procurar seu distrito atual, descobrir quem o desenhou e sob quais regras, e acompanhar como quaisquer desafios legais são resolvidos antes do Dia da Eleição.

segments.tr: Kedua partai utama telah dituduh menggunakan teknik ini, dan masing-masing cenderung membela petanya sendiri sebagai sah sambil mengkritik peta pihak lain.

segments.src: Researchers use measures such as the efficiency gap, the mean-median difference and computer-simulated map comparisons to estimate how much a map favors one side, though experts disagree about which measures are most reliable and about where acceptable line-drawing ends and gerrymandering begins.
segments.tr: Para peneliti menggunakan ukuran seperti kesenjangan efisiensi, perbedaan mean-median, dan perbandingan peta yang disimulasikan komputer untuk memperkirakan seberapa besar peta mendukung satu sisi, meskipun para ahli tidak setuju tentang ukuran mana yang paling dapat diandalkan dan tentang di mana batasan penggambaran garis yang dapat diterima dan gerrymandering dimulai.

segments.src: ## What Courts Have Said
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Dikatakan Pengadilan

segments.src: Several landmark decisions shape what courts will and will not do.
segments.tr: Beberapa keputusan penting membentuk apa yang akan dan tidak akan dilakukan oleh pengadilan.

segments.src: - **Partisan gerrymandering and federal courts.** In *Rucho v. Common Cause* (2019), the Supreme Court held that claims of excessive partisan gerrymandering present political questions that federal courts cannot resolve. The Court noted that state courts and state law, as well as Congress, could still play a role.
segments.tr: - **Partisan gerrymandering and federal courts.** Dalam *Rucho v. Common Cause* (2019), Mahkamah Agung memutuskan bahwa klaim gerrymandering partisan yang berlebihan menghadirkan pertanyaan politik yang tidak dapat diselesaikan oleh pengadilan federal. Mahkamah mencatat bahwa pengadilan negara bagian dan hukum negara bagian, serta Kongres, masih dapat berperan.

segments.src: - **Race and the Voting Rights Act.** In *Allen v. Milligan* (2023), the Court upheld the application of Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act to Alabama's congressional map, leaving in place a requirement to consider an additional district where minority voters could elect a candidate of their choice. Later litigation, including a case from Louisiana, has tested how far those protections extend and how they interact with the Constitution's limits on racial classifications.
segments.tr: - **Race and the Voting Rights Act.** Dalam *Allen v. Milligan* (2023), Mahkamah menegakkan penerapan Bagian 2 dari Voting Rights Act pada peta kongres Alabama, meninggalkan persyaratan untuk mempertimbangkan distrik tambahan di mana pemilih minoritas dapat memilih kandidat pilihan mereka. Litigasi lanjutan, termasuk kasus dari Louisiana, telah menguji seberapa jauh perlindungan tersebut meluas dan bagaimana perlindungan tersebut berinteraksi dengan batasan Konstitusi pada klasifikasi rasial.

segments.src: - **Separating race from party.** In *Alexander v. South Carolina State Conference of the NAACP* (2024), the Court emphasized that challengers must overcome a presumption that legislatures act in good faith and must account for the possibility that partisan goals, rather than racial ones, explain a district's shape.
segments.tr: - **Separating race from party.** Dalam *Alexander v. South Carolina State Conference of the NAACP* (2024), Mahkamah menekankan bahwa para penantang harus mengatasi anggapan bahwa badan legislatif bertindak dengan iktikad baik dan harus memperhitungkan kemungkinan bahwa tujuan partisan, daripada tujuan rasial, menjelaskan bentuk sebuah distrik.

segments.src: - **State courts.** In *Moore v. Harper* (2023), the Court rejected a broad version of the "independent state legislature" theory, confirming that state courts may review congressional maps under their state constitutions. As a result, many of the most consequential map disputes are decided under state law.
segments.tr: - **State courts.** Dalam *Moore v. Harper* (2023), Mahkamah menolak versi luas dari teori "independent state legislature", mengonfirmasi bahwa pengadilan negara bagian dapat meninjau peta kongres di bawah konstitusi negara bagian mereka. Akibatnya, banyak perselisihan peta yang paling penting diputuskan di bawah hukum negara bagian.

segments.src: - **Timing of challenges.** Federal courts have also been reluctant to change maps close to an election. The Court has cited concerns about voter confusion and administrative burden, an idea often called the Purcell principle, when letting maps stay in place while lawsuits continue.
segments.tr: - **Timing of challenges.** Pengadilan federal juga enggan mengubah peta menjelang pemilu. Mahkamah telah mengutip kekhawatiran tentang kebingungan pemilih dan beban administratif, sebuah gagasan yang sering disebut prinsip Purcell, ketika membiarkan peta tetap di tempatnya sementara tuntutan hukum berlanjut.

segments.src: Taken together, these rulings mean that the main checks on partisan map drawing now come from state constitutions, state courts, ballot measures and the voters themselves, rather than from federal courts.
segments.tr: Jika diambil bersama-sama, putusan ini berarti bahwa pemeriksaan utama pada penggambaran peta partisan sekarang berasal dari konstitusi negara bagian, pengadilan negara bagian, pemungutan suara, dan para pemilih itu sendiri, daripada dari pengadilan federal.

segments.src: Racial discrimination claims under the Voting Rights Act and the Constitution remain a federal avenue, but the legal standards are still being refined.
segments.tr: Klaim diskriminasi rasial di bawah Voting Rights Act dan Konstitusi tetap menjadi jalur federal, tetapi standar hukum masih disempurnakan.

segments.src: ## The Role of Voters and Ballot Measures
segments.tr: ## Peran Pemilih dan Pemungutan Suara

segments.src: In several states, voters have been asked to weigh in directly.
segments.tr: Di beberapa negara bagian, para pemilih telah diminta untuk menimbangnya secara langsung.

segments.src: Past ballot measures created independent commissions in states such as California, Michigan and Colorado.
segments.tr: Pemungutan suara masa lalu menciptakan komisi independen di negara bagian seperti California, Michigan, dan Colorado.

segments.src: More recently, mid-decade fights have included proposals that would temporarily suspend or change those arrangements in response to maps drawn elsewhere.
segments.tr: Lebih baru-baru ini, pertarungan pertengahan dekade telah menyertakan usulan yang akan menangguhkan atau mengubah pengaturan tersebut sementara sebagai tanggapan atas peta yang digambar di tempat lain.

segments.src: Supporters say such measures give voters a say in how the rules apply.
segments.tr: Para pendukung mengatakan langkah-langkah tersebut memberi pemilih hak suara dalam bagaimana aturan diterapkan.

segments.src: Opponents say they undercut the reforms voters previously approved.
segments.tr: Para penentang mengatakan mereka merusak reformasi yang sebelumnya disetujui oleh pemilih.

segments.src: These debates show how the question has shifted from "who should draw the lines" to "when, and under what rules."
segments.tr: Perdebatan ini menunjukkan bagaimana pertanyaan telah bergeser dari "siapa yang harus menggambar garis" menjadi "kapan, dan di bawah aturan apa."

segments.src: ## What to Watch
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Harus Diperhatikan

segments.src: For readers following the story, a few practical points help in sorting out claims and counterclaims:
segments.tr: Bagi para pembaca yang mengikuti cerita ini, beberapa poin praktis membantu dalam memilah klaim dan klaim tandingan:

segments.src: - **Check the status of each map.** A map passed by a legislature may be challenged in court, blocked, modified or approved. Whether it is used in a given election depends on the final outcome and the calendar.
segments.tr: - **Check the status of each map.** Peta yang disahkan oleh badan legislatif dapat ditantang di pengadilan, diblokir, dimodifikasi, atau disetujui. Apakah peta itu digunakan dalam pemilu tertentu bergantung pada hasil akhir dan kalender.

segments.src: - **Look at candidate filing deadlines and primaries.** Courts are more reluctant to disrupt maps once the election process is underway.
segments.tr: - **Look at candidate filing deadlines and primaries.** Pengadilan lebih enggan mengganggu peta begitu proses pemilu sedang berjalan.

segments.src: - **Compare proposed districts with past results.** Local election data show how competitive a new district is likely to be, but turnout and the national environment can change the outcome.
segments.tr: - **Compare proposed districts with past results.** Data pemilu lokal menunjukkan seberapa kompetitif distrik baru nantinya, tetapi partisipasi dan lingkungan nasional dapat mengubah hasilnya.

segments.src: - **Separate legal questions from political ones.** A map can be legal and still controversial, or it can be popular with one party and unpopular with the other. Courts typically address only the legal question.
segments.tr: - **Separate legal questions from political ones.** Sebuah peta bisa legal dan tetap kontroversial, atau bisa populer dengan satu partai dan tidak populer dengan yang lain. Pengadilan biasanya hanya membahas pertanyaan hukum.

segments.src: - **Consult official sources.** State election offices, court filings and nonpartisan trackers publish current maps and rulings.
segments.tr: - **Consult official sources.** Kantor pemilu negara bagian, pengajuan pengadilan, dan pelacak nonpartisan mempublikasikan peta dan putusan saat ini.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Intinya

segments.src: District lines determine how votes become seats, and in a closely divided House, a few redrawn districts can have an outsized effect.
segments.tr: Garis distrik menentukan bagaimana suara menjadi kursi, dan di DPR yang terbagi erat, beberapa distrik yang digambar ulang dapat memiliki efek yang luar biasa.

segments.src: The current wave of mid-decade redistricting has pushed a technical, normally once-a-decade process into the center of the campaign.
segments.tr: Gelombang redistricting pertengahan dekade saat ini telah mendorong proses teknis yang biasanya terjadi sekali dalam satu dekade ke pusat kampanye.

segments.src: Courts have drawn some boundaries around what is allowed, especially on race, while leaving much of the question of partisan advantage to states and voters.
segments.tr: Pengadilan telah menggambar beberapa batasan tentang apa yang diizinkan, terutama pada ras, sementara menyerahkan banyak pertanyaan tentang keuntungan partisan kepada negara bagian dan pemilih.

segments.src: Readers who want to understand the stakes in their own state should look up their current district, find out who drew it and under what rules, and follow how any legal challenges are resolved before Election Day.
segments.tr: Pembaca yang ingin memahami taruhan di negara bagian mereka sendiri harus mencari distrik mereka saat ini, mencari tahu siapa yang menggambarnya dan di bawah aturan apa, dan mengikuti bagaimana tantangan hukum diselesaikan sebelum Hari Pemilu.
